name: 章ごとの読書の問い
prompt:
Edit the LH05-0145 neutral chapter-question list in reference 1. Reference 2 is the exact 390 by 660 target. The current candidate has the correct copy and colors, but the title and all rows sit about 10 to 20px too low and the last row is close to the bottom. Move the content up and restore the exact native anchors, leaving clear bottom margin.

Keep the pure white background and the no-tint treatment: no colored fills, panels, badges, gradients, shadows or green wash. Keep the title near-black, chapter labels neutral gray, and question text near-black. Preserve the same visual hierarchy, text sizes and content. Do not introduce forest-green text except a tiny restrained heading accent if needed.

Canvas 390 by 660. Left x16, width358. Heading 読書の問い starts at y8, Meiryo Bold 20px, 28px line height. Eight chapter/question groups remain on the exact native rows: chapter labels at y56, 134, 212, 290, 368, 446, 524, 602; question bodies at y80, 158, 236, 314, 392, 470, 548, 626. Chapter labels and bodies use Meiryo Regular 12px with 16px line height. Ensure the final question is fully visible and leaves about18px of white space below it. Use one-line text as in the preview; do not increase font size or vertical spacing.

Preserve every Japanese string in the exact same order as reference 2. The eight pairs are: 第4章・陰謀 / 三人はなぜダンテスを憎むのでしょう。; 第12章・父と息子 / 二組の父子の愛と忠誠を比べてみましょう。; 第17章・司祭の部屋 / ファリアとの関係は、彼にどんな変化を与えますか。; 第21章・ティブーレン島 / 島に流れ着いた彼は、入獄前とどう違いますか。; 第25章・見知らぬ人 / ヤコポへの寛大さから、彼の価値観を考えましょう。; 第30章・9月5日 / モレルを助ける行動には、何が働いているのでしょう。; 第34章・コロセウム / 伯爵を吸血鬼と見る夫人の考えをどう読みますか。; 第37章・地下墓地 / アルベールと伯爵の対比から、何が見えてきますか。

Reference 3 is the original Fable screenshot, already inspected; exclude its phone chrome and additional pages. Do not add containers or dividers. Use only typography and whitespace to group the content. Keep all surfaces white and neutral.
reviewNotes: All eight questions are visible on white with neutral text, but the heading and first groups remain slightly low and the final bottom margin is smaller than the native preview.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
